technical_and_design_decisions: U1: Prepare migration documentation and porting guidelines detailing SPI and configuration changes from version 1.0 to 1.1.
U2: Create a dedicated sample project under spring-xd-samples demonstrating Pig job submission and stream integration.
U3: Modify Gradle build scripts, fix file separator assumptions, and standardize script line endings to support Windows native builds.
U4: Provision an AWS EC2 Windows instance, set up a CI agent, run acceptance tests, and resolve Windows-specific file path/process execution failures.
U5: Implement a Spark Streaming module integration for Spring XD, providing reference processor implementations in both Java 8 (with Lambdas) and Scala.
U6: Update Asciidoctor/DocBook documentation build properties to display 2015 in the generated reference manual PDF.
U7: Port custom Kafka modifications from Spring XD into Spring Integration Kafka, update project dependencies to SI Kafka GA, and fix API breaking changes.
U8: Upgrade Spring for Apache Hadoop (SHDP) dependency version to GA release, update module configurations, and execute Hadoop-related test suites.
assumptions: A single software developer will perform all design, implementation, testing, documentation, and CI setup tasks.
AWS credentials and EC2 infrastructure permissions are readily available for provisioning Windows build instances.
Spring XD build environment relies on standard Gradle tooling and access to public/internal Maven repositories.
Acceptance test suite is already structured and runnable on Linux/macOS, requiring adaptation and execution fixes for Windows OS.

activities.activity_name: U1: Migration and Porting Guide (1.0 to 1.1)
activities.activity_description: Analyze API/SPI changes between versions 1.0 and 1.1, author documentation for migrating custom modules, and verify module migration on sample modules.
Develop a Pig script sample project integrated with Spring XD stream/job definitions, write user setup documentation, and add integration tests.
Fix Gradle build scripts, path generation logic, line endings, and batch wrappers to allow full compilation and testing on a local Windows machine.

activities.activity_name: U4: Windows EC2 Provisioning and CI Acceptance Testing
activities.activity_description: Provision a Windows EC2 instance, configure CI build agent, run acceptance tests, fix Windows-specific test execution issues, and integrate build steps into CI.

activities.activity_name: U5: Spark Streaming Data Processors (Java & Scala)
activities.activity_description: Design and implement Spark Streaming processors for Spring XD using Java 8 Lambdas and Scala, including build configurations and unit/integration tests.
Update copyright year metadata to 2015 in the documentation source files and verify PDF generation output.

activities.activity_name: U7: Backport Kafka Changes and Upgrade to SI Kafka GA
activities.activity_description: Backport Spring XD custom Kafka features to Spring Integration Kafka, bump SI Kafka dependency to GA, and resolve resulting compilation and integration test issues.

activities.activity_name: U8: Upgrade to SHDP GA Release
activities.activity_description: Upgrade Spring for Apache Hadoop (SHDP) dependencies to GA release, adjust API usage across Hadoop modules, and verify compatibility with existing tests.
